title: Reported anti-government protest activity in Fano-held Amhara towns during 18 December rallies
location: Some Amhara towns under Fano control; exact towns and sites are not named
scope: Borkena and APA report anti-government protests or chants in some locations during/alongside pro-government peace rallies. The anti-government portions are not sufficiently distinguished from state-backed rallies to resolve event unit or state-directed demand.
organizer: Unknown; state reportedly organized/coerced the pro-government rally component; organizers of anti-government activity are unknown.
threshold_50_evidence: No per-location or crowd estimate supports simultaneous threshold.

start_date.summary: Sources place the reported rallies on Wednesday 18 December.

end_date.summary: No duration or end date for the anti-government portions is reported.

location.summary: Some Amhara/Fano-held towns are referenced; the exact towns and gathering sites are unspecified.

organizer.summary: The pro-government rally was reportedly state-organized; anti-government protest organizers are not identified.

demands.summary: Anti-government slogans/protests are reported, but specific demands directed at the Ethiopian state are not stated.

participants_original.summary: No crowd estimate is reported for anti-government portions or individual locations.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No per-site attendance evidence; separate anti-government gathering scale unknown.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence is attributed to the anti-government crowd; grenade attacks are reported but perpetrators/context are separate and unresolved.

state_response.summary: Reports include government security presence and dispersal of one rally after anti-government slogans; event-specific response to distinct protests is unclear.

notes: Reports point to possible state-targeted opposition during or alongside pro-government rallies, but unit, demand and threshold are unresolved. APA/Borkena/ENA source independence is not assumed.
open_questions: Which town(s) hosted separate anti-government gatherings versus a shift in slogans within pro-government rallies?
What demands were directed at the Ethiopian state, beyond generic anti-government slogans?
Did any distinct gathering have at least 50 people simultaneously?
Who organized the anti-government portions and how did they relate to state-organized rallies?
Did the reported grenade attacks occur at a protest site and what was their effect on participants?
Was this one event or multiple town-level gatherings?
